name: read-only
description: Recommended profile: auto-allow read-only inspection across the shell, git, gh, and common language ecosystems (pip/uv/python, npm/pnpm/yarn/bun/node, cargo/rustup, go, poetry, make, just). Anything that writes, runs project code, or is otherwise not a pure read defers to the harness (which prompts the human). A small set of irreversible, system-level operations is denied outright. Output redirections are not permitted on allowed commands (writes are blocked), except scratch writes under /tmp.

rules.name: read: shell inspection commands
rules.description: Builtins and coreutils that read state or transform stdin→stdout but never write files or mutate the system. Excludes anything that runs another command (env, command, xargs, watch, sudo), has a file-writing mode (tee, sort -o, shuf -o, xxd's output-file positional), or is an interactive pager that can spawn a shell (less/more via !cmd or LESSOPEN, man via -P). shuf stays (its only write mode, -o, is denied below).

rules.name: read: echo/printf/cat may write scratch under /tmp
rules.description: Output redirection is otherwise denied; permit only throwaway scratch files under /tmp.

rules.name: read: stream filters in pipes and substitutions
rules.description: Filters that transform stdin→stdout, scoped to pipe/substitution roles. Excludes awk and sed: both are interpreters that run arbitrary shell (awk system()/print|cmd, GNU sed e/w), so role-scoping does not contain them. Also excludes uniq and xxd, whose optional output-file positional writes a file in any role. sort stays here but its -o write mode is denied below.

rules.name: git read-only: worktree/submodule/notes listings
rules.match: git @(worktree list|submodule|submodule status|submodule summary|notes list|notes show)?( *)

rules.name: gh read-only: api GET
rules.description: Raw API reads. Write methods and body-field flags are denied below so only GET-style requests are allowed.

rules.name: deny: gh api body fields (imply a write request)
node read-only: version only (node runs arbitrary code)
npm read-only: config get / pkg get / audit (report only)
python read-only: version, pip reads, json formatter
uv version (read; a bare report, not a bump)
poetry version (read; a bare report, not a bump)
go env read-only (deny -w/-u which mutate config)
make read-only: version/help only
rules.description: Only --version/--help, which print and exit without reading a Makefile. The introspection modes (-n/--dry-run, -p/--print-data-base, -q/--question) are NOT reads: make expands top-level $(shell ...), `!=`, and $(eval ...) during the Makefile read-in phase that all three perform, so they can run project-controlled shell. -n only suppresses recipe execution, not this evaluation.

rules.name: just read-only: list / show recipes (does not run them)
rules.description: Listing and showing recipes parse the Justfile without evaluating it. --evaluate is excluded: it forces evaluation of all variables, running any backtick or shell-derived assignment (project-controlled shell).

rules.name: deny: never read private keys or credentials
rules.description: Block reading well-known secret material (SSH/private keys, cloud and registry credentials, the gh OAuth token store) through common file readers, to limit accidental exfiltration. The engine also applies this to input-redirection targets, so `cat < ~/.ssh/id_rsa` is denied like `cat ~/.ssh/id_rsa`.

rules.name: deny: sort/shuf write to a file (-o/--output)
rules.description: sort and shuf are otherwise safe stdin→stdout filters, but -o/--output (and the attached -oFILE / --output=FILE forms) writes a file in any role, bypassing the shell-redirection gate. Block that one write mode rather than dropping the tools.

rules.name: deny: recursive rm
rules.description: Recursive delete is never auto-allowed; route file removal through git or a human prompt. Flags are matched as whole space-delimited tokens so a filename like '--preserve-root' or 'my-report' is not mistaken for '-r'.

rules.name: deny: git branch delete/rename/copy/force
rules.description: git branch lists branches read-only, but -d/-D/-m/-M/-c/-C/--force mutate refs; block them in every position.

rules.name: deny: dd to a block device
deny: recursive chmod/chown on absolute or home paths
deny: shell as a pipe target (blocks curl | sh)
